messages:
Devon H: Heads-up — thinking about an 'explain-mode' for auto-fallbacks. Right now ops just see 'fallback applied' and can't reason about it. Proposal: attach a short rationale + the predicate set that triggered the fallback to each audit event. Thoughts?

Maria T: +1. We should avoid dumping user content — only show signal buckets (latency, error_rate, token_cost, quota) and a short human-friendly reason. :thumbsup:

Sam K: Could be noisy if we dump every signal. Suggest condensed reasons like 'latency>200ms (p95)' or 'error-rate>2%'. Also an optional link to the runbook. @Priya R — any compliance concerns?

Priya R: Retention and redaction are the big ones. We need retention defaults (90d for rollout traces, 365d for enterprise) and model-level KMS tags. UI must never show raw user prompts unless explicitly redacted/sampled.

Lorenzo: For the Console, propose a compact pill: reason + confidence, with an expandable 'why' panel showing predicate logic and 1–2 sanitized samples. Sketch of the audit payload we could emit:

```
{
  "fallback_reason": "latency",
  "predicate": "p95>200ms",
  "confidence": 0.87,
  "sample_requests": ["<sanitized>"]
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created index fallback-events-v2 (docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/fallback-audit)

Devon H: UX question: do we separate 'auto-degrade' vs 'operator-override' in the badge? I want distinct colors + a mute option so product teams can avoid alert fatigue.

Maria T: Agree — also add a per-rollout toggle 'explain_mode: brief | detailed | off'. Default to 'brief'. :zap:

Sam K: Implementation note: we'll need an API change. Add explain_mode to the rollout create/update endpoints. Example:

```
POST /v1/rollouts
{
  "policy": "...",
  "auto_fallback": true,
  "explain_mode": "brief"
}
```

Priya R: Add 'omit_user_content' boolean and 'redact_level': 'partial'|'full' to the API. That covers compliance for customers who can't let any user-derived tokens leave their VPC.

Devon H: Sounds good. Action items: Maria + Priya add retention/KMS checklist to the rollout PR; Sam to draft API spec; Lorenzo to mock the UI (no pixels required). Sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC?

Maria T: I'll add the checklist now. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: I'll open the API draft after the checklist lands.

Lorenzo: Will drop a quick Figma link by EOD.

ops-bot: reminder: rollout experiments preferred during 04:00-08:00 UTC to avoid peak traffic. :alarm_clock:

Devon H: Thanks everyone — let's keep the explain payload tight and redact by default.
